plain: A string of odd-looking tokens added to the end of a request, found by search, that makes a model comply when it would refuse.
eli5: A magic nonsense phrase that, when added to a question, tricks the robot into saying yes.
technical: A sequence of tokens appended to a prompt and optimised, usually by gradient-guided search such as GCG (Zou et al. 2023), to maximise the probability of an affirmative target opening; it needs white-box access to compute, though found suffixes can transfer to other models.
